statements.statement: The service billed was cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The denial reason code was PR-204
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known atrial fibrillation
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease
Cardiac event monitoring was indicated to further characterize the frequency and burden of arrhythmic events and guide ongoing management
The service was denied as not covered under the member's current benefit plan
